_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate plus absent ETF/stablecoin/fed-liquidity impulse keeps the score pinned on Anxiety; HOLD is the graded call until a real breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety; analyst supplies the HOLD forward call while narrative is non-committal/low-conf, so consensus adopts analyst direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds roughly a 1.5% 24h range and fear/greed stays ~25-35 with ETF and stablecoin factors still suppressed
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF or stablecoin impulse with fear/greed reclaiming above 45 (up a rung) or a price flush into extreme fear that knocks the score into Denial/Panic (down a rung)
